runner_source:
"""Run only after final tools are frozen and task-owned heavy jobs have stopped."""

import argparse
import hashlib
import json
import subprocess
import sys
from datetime import datetime, timezone
from pathlib import Path

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]
LOCAL = ROOT / "benchmarks/local"
SESSION = LOCAL / "scalar-fstrings-final-session.json"
SNAPSHOT = LOCAL / "scalar-fstrings-baseline-source"
CACHE_PROBE = r"""
import hashlib, importlib.util, json, pathlib, struct, sys
records = {}
for source in sorted(pathlib.Path(sys.argv[1]).rglob('*.py')):
    cached = pathlib.Path(importlib.util.cache_from_source(str(source)))
    data, content = cached.read_bytes(), source.read_bytes()
    assert data[:4] == importlib.util.MAGIC_NUMBER, source
    flags = int.from_bytes(data[4:8], 'little')
    if flags & 1:
        assert data[8:16] == importlib.util.source_hash(content), source
    else:
        timestamp, size = struct.unpack('<II', data[8:16])
        assert timestamp == (int(source.stat().st_mtime) & 0xffffffff), source
        assert size == (len(content) & 0xffffffff), source
    records[str(source)] = {'source_sha256': hashlib.sha256(content).hexdigest(), 'cache_path': str(cached), 'cache_sha256': hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest(), 'cache_bytes': len(data), 'flags': flags, 'source_mtime_ns': source.stat().st_mtime_ns, 'valid_header': True}
print(json.dumps({'python': sys.version, 'cache_tag': sys.implementation.cache_tag, 'magic': importlib.util.MAGIC_NUMBER.hex(), 'pycache_prefix': sys.pycache_prefix, 'dont_write_bytecode': sys.dont_write_bytecode, 'files': records}))
"""


def sha(path):
    return hashlib.sha256(path.read_bytes()).hexdigest()


def git(*arguments):
    return subprocess.check_output(["git", "-C", str(ROOT), *arguments])


def clean_sources(tools, expected_head=None):
    head = git("rev-parse", "HEAD").decode().strip()
    if (
        git("status", "--porcelain")
        or expected_head is not None
        and head != expected_head
    ):
        raise RuntimeError("final comparisons require one unchanged clean checkout")
    record = json.loads((tools / "build-record.json").read_text())
    for name, expected in record["source_sha256"].items():
        if (
            sha(ROOT / name) != expected
            or hashlib.sha256(git("show", head + ":" + name)).hexdigest() != expected
        ):
            raise RuntimeError(
                "frozen compiled source differs from clean HEAD: " + name
            )
    application_sources = {}
    for path in sorted((ROOT / "examples/inventory_reconciliation").rglob("*.py")):
        name = str(path.relative_to(ROOT))
        application_sources[name] = sha(path)
        if (
            hashlib.sha256(git("show", head + ":" + name)).hexdigest()
            != application_sources[name]
        ):
            raise RuntimeError("application source differs from clean HEAD: " + name)
    return {
        "head": head,
        "dirty": False,
        "all_compiled_sources_match_commit": True,
        "application_source_sha256": application_sources,
        "build_record_sha256": sha(tools / "build-record.json"),
    }


def snapshot_identity():
    manifest = json.loads((SNAPSHOT / "manifest.json").read_text())
    sources = {
        str(path.relative_to(SNAPSHOT)): sha(path)
        for path in sorted((SNAPSHOT / "inventory_reconciliation").rglob("*.py"))
    }
    if manifest["sources"] != sources:
        raise RuntimeError("preserved source snapshot differs from manifest")
    current = {
        str(path.relative_to(ROOT / "examples")): sha(path)
        for path in sorted((ROOT / "examples/inventory_reconciliation").rglob("*.py"))
    }
    changes = {
        name: {
            "baseline_sha256": sources.get(name),
            "current_sha256": current.get(name),
        }
        for name in sorted(sources.keys() | current.keys())
        if sources.get(name) != current.get(name)
    }
    if set(changes) != {"inventory_reconciliation/render.py"}:
        raise RuntimeError("this comparison expects only the renderer syntax change")
    for value in manifest["baseline_records"].values():
        if (
            sha(Path(value["record_path"])) != value["record_sha256"]
            or sha(Path(value["binary_path"])) != value["binary_sha256"]
        ):
            raise RuntimeError("preserved optimized baseline artifact changed")
    return {
        "manifest_path": str(SNAPSHOT / "manifest.json"),
        "manifest_sha256": sha(SNAPSHOT / "manifest.json"),
        "snapshot_root": str(SNAPSHOT),
        "recorded_sources": sources,
        "current_sources": current,
        "changed_sources": changes,
    }


def main():
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    parser.add_argument(
        "--tools", type=Path, default=LOCAL / "scalar-fstrings-tools-final"
    )
    args = parser.parse_args()
    tools = args.tools.resolve(strict=True)
    if SESSION.exists():
        raise RuntimeError("final session record must be new: " + str(SESSION))
    before = clean_sources(tools)
    snapshot_before = snapshot_identity()
    old_normal = json.loads(
        (LOCAL / "inventory-performance-normal-final.json").read_text()
    )
    python = old_normal["method"]["commands"]["inventory"]["cpython"][0]
    cache_prepare = [
        python,
        "-I",
        "-m",
        "compileall",
        "-q",
        str(ROOT / "examples/inventory_reconciliation"),
    ]
    prepared = subprocess.run(cache_prepare, cwd=ROOT, capture_output=True, check=True)

    def caches():
        command = [
            python,
            "-I",
            "-c",
            CACHE_PROBE,
            str(ROOT / "examples/inventory_reconciliation"),
        ]
        return json.loads(subprocess.check_output(command, cwd=ROOT, text=True))

    session = {
        "command": [sys.executable, *sys.argv],
        "launcher_sha256": sha(Path(__file__)),
        "runner_source": Path(__file__).read_text(),
        "before": before,
        "runs": {},
        "started_at_utc": datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(),
        "source_commit": before["head"],
        "git_status_before": "",
        "baseline_source_before": snapshot_before,
        "cache_preparation": {
            "command": cache_prepare,
            "returncode": prepared.returncode,
            "stdout_sha256": hashlib.sha256(prepared.stdout).hexdigest(),
            "stderr_sha256": hashlib.sha256(prepared.stderr).hexdigest(),
            "timed": False,
        },
        "bytecode_before": caches(),
    }
    for mode in ("normal", "lto"):
        guard = clean_sources(tools, before["head"])
        old_path = LOCAL / f"inventory-performance-{mode}-final.json"
        old = json.loads(old_path.read_text())
        old_compile = old["method"]["compile_commands"]["inventory"]
        clang = old_compile[old_compile.index("--clang") + 1]
        output = LOCAL / f"scalar-fstrings-{mode}-final.json"
        if output.exists() or output.with_suffix("").exists():
            raise RuntimeError("final output must be new: " + str(output))
        command = [
            sys.executable,
            "-u",
            str(ROOT / "benchmarks/inventory_benchmark.py"),
            "--compiler",
            str(tools / "relar"),
            "--runtime",
            str(
                tools
                / ("librelar_runtime_lto.a" if mode == "lto" else "librelar_runtime.a")
            ),
            "--relar-build-record",
            str(tools / "build-record.json"),
            "--rust-bigint",
            str(LOCAL / f"inventory-reference-final-{mode}/inventory-bigint"),
            "--rust-build-record",
            str(LOCAL / f"inventory-reference-final-{mode}/build-record.json"),
            "--inventory-baseline",
            str(LOCAL / f"inventory-performance-{mode}-final/inventory_reconciliation"),
            "--inventory-baseline-record",
            str(old_path),
            "--inventory-baseline-source-root",
            str(SNAPSHOT),
            "--python",
            python,
            "--clang",
            clang,
            "--target",
            "x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu",
            "--samples",
            "48",
            "--warmups",
            "2",
            "--cpu",
            "0",
            "--output",
            str(output),
            "--artifact-dir",
            str(output.with_suffix("")),
        ]
        if mode == "lto":
            command += ["--lto-linker", str(LOCAL / "batch-linker/ld.lld")]
        log_path = output.with_suffix(".log")
        item = {
            "mode": mode,
            "command": command,
            "source_guard": guard,
            "started_at_utc": datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(),
        }
        session["runs"][mode] = item
        SESSION.write_text(json.dumps(session, indent=2) + "\n")
        print("Starting final " + mode, flush=True)
        with log_path.open("w") as log:
            process = subprocess.Popen(
                command,
                cwd=ROOT,
                stdout=subprocess.PIPE,
                stderr=subprocess.STDOUT,
                text=True,
            )
            for line in process.stdout:
                log.write(line)
                log.flush()
                print(line, end="", flush=True)
            status = process.wait()
        item.update(
            returncode=status,
            completed_at_utc=datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(),
            log_sha256=sha(log_path),
        )
        if output.exists():
            item["record_sha256"] = sha(output)
        SESSION.write_text(json.dumps(session, indent=2) + "\n")
        if status:
            raise SystemExit(status)
        item["source_guard_after"] = clean_sources(tools, before["head"])
        if caches() != session["bytecode_before"]:
            raise RuntimeError("Python package cache bytes changed during measurement")
        if snapshot_identity() != snapshot_before:
            raise RuntimeError("baseline source snapshot changed during measurement")
        old_ir = Path(old_compile[old_compile.index("--emit-llvm") + 1])
        new_ir = output.with_suffix("") / "inventory_reconciliation.ll"
        item["generated_ir_comparison"] = {
            "baseline_path": str(old_ir),
            "baseline_sha256": sha(old_ir),
            "current_path": str(new_ir),
            "current_sha256": sha(new_ir),
            "byte_identical": old_ir.read_bytes() == new_ir.read_bytes(),
        }
        SESSION.write_text(json.dumps(session, indent=2) + "\n")
    session.update(
        bytecode_after=caches(),
        baseline_source_after=snapshot_identity(),
        git_status_after=git("status", "--porcelain").decode(),
        completed_at_utc=datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(),
    )
    if sha(Path(__file__)) != session["launcher_sha256"]:
        raise RuntimeError("launcher changed during measurement")
    SESSION.write_text(json.dumps(session, indent=2) + "\n")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
